rows.text: when `001BE420()` returns non-null, calls `001BE420()` again and stores `ecx` at dword `+0x20` of the result; otherwise returns without work
calls `00267E10(r9)` and stores its low byte at byte `+0xD` of `r8`; stores 1 at byte `+0xC` of `r8` when `002647C0` of that result is non-zero, else 0 (`setne`); then tail-jumps `0026B4A0(rdx, 0xB)`
